answer_1.quote: Our Contribution: We propose a novel task of intent-specific counterspeech generation that aims to generate a counterspeech for a given hate speech and a desired counterspeech intent.

answer_2.quote: We employ Rouge and Meteor scores to evaluate the syntactic correctness of the generated counterspeech.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a comprehensive human evaluation on a random subset of the generated counterspeeches... We ask our evaluators to rate the outputs on the following metrics: Independent CS (IC) denotes whether the generated instance can be considered as CS without any context; Conditioned CS (CC) shows whether the generated output is an appropriate response to the given hate speech; Adequacy (A) depicts whether the generated CS is grammatically sound, coherent and fluent; Toxicity (T) indicates whether the output can be considered toxic. Category Accuracy (CA) determines if the counterspeech adheres to the desired intent;
answer_4.guideline: evaluators rate outputs on metrics using a 5-point Likert scale and assign intents for CA
